Suddenly the doorbell rings, Aunt Zhang opens the door, it is her neighbor Aunt Li who comes to visit. Aunt Li smiles and says: "Aunt Zhang, hello." Aunt Zhang also smiles and says: "Aunt Li, please come in, it's been a long time." After Aunt Li comes in, she sees Xiao Fang sitting on the sofa and says to her: "Hello, I don't think I've seen this little boy before, what's your name?" Xiao Fang looks up at Aunt Li and doesn't say anything. At this time, Aunt Zhang comes over and says: "Come and have some tea, the weather is really good today."

Does Aunt Li know that Xiaofang is a girl?
